'''Black Curs Base''' was the operation base for the [[Black Curs]], an independent [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group affiliated with the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] in the [[Standard year|years]] immediately following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Its location was kept secret from anyone outside the team, including the Curs' allies in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> It occupied parts of a long-abandoned [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base, namely the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and command center; the rest of the base remained in a ruined state. A few well-hidden gunnery emplacements defended the base. The core members of the Black Curs lived in makeshift quarters alongside their support personnel, made up mostly of orphaned young people whom the mercs had recruited. Some of these crew had even younger siblings living with them at the base.<ref name="Blues">{{JournalCite|8|Black Curs Blues}}</ref>
